commits_data.message:
packet-c2p.c: General improvements

1. val_to_str -> val_to_str_wmem
2. Remove formal declaration of custom field functions, they aren't used until the bottom of the file when registering fields
3. Remove unnecessary snprintf (many are needed for formatting fields)
4. Use proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint instead of some custom helper functions to get fields.
